reviewer: Claude (Opus 5.5) review agent reviewer-gfm-a, independent of the extractor lit-gfm-2; no human review claimed
scope: Independent review of the Bůžková et al. 2026 batch (bioRxiv 10.64898/2026.09.25.754388v1): 196 records after review (1 source, 1 model, 42 configurations, 3 datasets, 3 protocols, 47 evaluations, 90 results, 9 claims). Every result checked against Tables 3, 7 and 10 and every claim against Table 2 by a separate parser (review/review.py) over the text layer of the pinned PDF, whose archived copy matches the pinned SHA-256. Details in review.md.
limitations: Automated review by a Claude agent; not human scientific review and not reproduction of any result.
Values were checked against the PDF text layer; figures were not read.
Tables 4, 5, 6, 8, 9 and 11 are unextracted and were read only to cross-check extracted values.
Table 9 prints 0.9244 for unperturbed NTv3-650M against 0.9265 in Tables 3, 6 and 7; not resolved.
corrections: Five accuracy results: printed 95% Wilson intervals (Sections 3.6 and 3.8) added; they had been marked unreported.
22 precision and recall results: qualifier now carries the dataset and chunk-scored marker like the other metrics of the row.
Four Table 10 foundation-model evaluations relinked to new configurations with pooling unreported; the paper does not state the long-sequence pooling.
Three chunked Table 10 evaluations: limitation added on the Section 2.5 versus Table 10 footnote conflict about chunk scoring.
Protocols: limitations added for unstated long-sequence pooling and the residual redundant label pair (Table 11).
data-rvdb-long: exact total 320 removed; Table 1 prints 'about 320'.
